title: When Can One Obtain Certificates of Optimality Using Positivstellensaetze?
abstract: arXiv:2609.08736v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study certificates of positivity and optimality for learning problems whose objectives and constraints need not be polynomial. We isolate an axiomatic core of Fischer's constructive strict and weak Positivstellens\"{a}tze and prove the resulting theorems for abstract function algebras over ordered fields. The framework separates two roles that can otherwise be conflated: objective and constraint functions may be built from broad classes of continuous or definable operations, while the auxiliary primitives used to construct a certificate satisfy explicit scalar and closure axioms. We give instances over continuous and definable function algebras, including ordered fields not closed under square roots, derive lower-bound and global-optimality certificates, and analyze both expanded term length and shared computation-graph complexity.

translated_title: 何时能够利用正性定理（Positivstellensätze）获得最优性证书？
translated_abstract: 我们研究学习问题的正性证书与最优性证书，此类问题的目标函数和约束函数不必是多项式。我们分离出Fischer构造性严格与弱正性定理的公理化核心，并在有序域上的抽象函数代数中证明了由此得到的定理。该框架区分了通常容易被混淆的两种角色：目标函数和约束函数可以由广泛的连续或可定义操作类构建，而用于构造证书的辅助原语则需满足明确的标量与闭包公理。我们给出了连续函数代数和可定义函数代数上的实例（包括在平方根运算下不封闭的有序域），推导了下界证书和全局最优性证书，并分析了展开项长度与共享计算图复杂度两种度量。
tldr: 本文提出一个抽象公理化框架，将Fischer的构造性正性定理推广至目标和约束非多项式的学习问题，从而能够在连续或可定义函数代数（包括平方根下不封闭的有序域）上获得全局最优性证书。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an abstract axiomatic framework generalizing Fischer's constructive strict and weak Positivstellensätze to learning problems with non-polynomial objectives and constraints, enabling lower-bound and global-optimality certificates over continuous or definable function algebras, including ordered fields not closed under square roots.
